UI_ZomVisFix_Options_Enable_Desc: turns the mod on or off (default: true)
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_AimingOnly_Desc: mod will reveal zombies only while you're in combat stance (default: false)
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_ZombieVision_Desc: let zombies revealed by this mod also detect the player (default: true)
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_StairOVision_Desc: reveal zombies that are at the top of the stairs you're climbing (default: true)
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_RaytracerFunc_Desc:
sub-tile precision = uses exact player and zombie positions
tile-based = built-in java raytracer (used by the game for weapon targeting), this still reveals more than vanilla does
both = zombies revealed by tile-based raytracer have 100%% opacity, zombies revealed by sub-tile raytracer use "zombie opacity" setting below
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_ZombieOpacity_Desc:
opacity of zombies revealed by this mod (this will not affect any other zombie)
if using the "both" raytracer setting, this value is ignored for zombies revealed by the tile-based raytracer
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_ZombieOpacityStairs: opacity of zombies revealed by stair-o-vision
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_ZombieProcessingLim: limit how many zombies this mod is allowed to process per tick (0 = no limit)
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_ZombieDistanceLimit: mod will process zombies only within this tile radius from the player (0 = use view distance)
UI_ZomVisFix_Options_ToggleKey_Desc: lets you press a key to toggle the "enabled" setting on or off
